subject: Revised shiny apps runs fine locally, but when deployed does not update

messages.author: 33dc9c6d026ee296
messages.subject: Revised shiny apps runs fine locally, but when deployed does not update
parts:
I have encountered a very strange problem.  I wrote and deployed a shiny app, then decided to make a change or two.  The revised version works fine locally.  When I deploy the new version to ShinyApps, I am told that the deployment was successful, but the hosted app behaves just the same old way.  I have tried using the app from a couple of different computer,s so I'm sure it's not one of those browser cache problems.  I've also tried teminateApp() followed by another deploy.

Even more strangely, I have installed the revised app on my College's Shiny server (as the revised version, not on top of an older version).  Yet I get the behavior of the previous version!  (The installation on the College server includes only the essential files (ui.R, server.R, and two .csv files) not the shinyapps sub-directory.

I've also tried doing it from two different sources:  from my Dropbox folder on my hard-drive, where the app was originally written and from a copy I made in my Home folder on my hard-drive.

Any thoughts on what more I could do to diagnose the problem?

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Revised shiny apps runs fine locally, but when deployed does not update
parts:
Homer,

This is very strange, but hard to say what is happening without more insight into your application's code, and the changes you have made. 
Would it be possible to share your code? 
What are the nature of changes you have made that do not get picked up?
Can you make some very obvious changes (for example a new text output in the ui), and see if this gets picked up after deploy?

And it would also be helpful if you provide the following info:
- output of sessionInfo() command
- Version of RStudio
- Version of Shiny Server and platform you are running it on.

Best,
Fereshteh

I'll have to ask about the version of the College's Shiny server; maybe for now we can focus on the shinyapps server.

 


I think I have identified a reasonably small example that might allow you to reproduce the issue:

First, create myFile.csv as follows:

"Total.scaled.score","major"
446,"X(area)"
479,"philosophy"
446,"philosophy"
429,"X(area)"
426,"X(area)"
439,"X(area)"
436,"X(area)"
470,"philosophy"
439,"X(area)"
441,"X(area)"
433,"X(area)"
498,"philosophy"
488,"philosophy"
481,"philosophy"
441,"philosophy"
481,"philosophy"
481,"philosophy"
454,"X(area)"
481,"philosophy"
451,"philosophy"

Then make ui.R:

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 
  #  Application title
  headerPanel("Testing"),
 
  # Sidebar
  sidebarPanel(
    helpText("Testing whether server reads 'major' variable in myFile.csv as a factor.")
   
   
   
  ), # end sidebar panel
 
 
  # Here comes the main panel
 
  mainPanel(
   
    verbatimTextOutput("csvFile")
   
  ) #end main panel
 
))

Then server.R:

library(shiny)


# Define server logic
shinyServer(function(input, output,session) {
 
  myFile <- read.csv("myFile.csv")
 
  output$csvFile <- renderPrint({
    levels(myFile$major)
  })
 
 
})

Run the app locally, and you see that the factor levels are in alphabetical order.  When I deploy to shinyapps, I see that the levels are reported in reverse order.

Hope this helps!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Revised shiny apps runs fine locally, but when deployed does not update
parts:
With the code you sent me I was able to see the same thing you reported (different order of levels). Is this the same issue that you had originally reported?

The order issue is caused by having different "locale settings" on your local machine, and the shinyapps.io server. This setting affects the character sorting, which determines the output of levels.
